items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What's the name of that trumpet player... [INTERVIEWEE] Valtrombone.

ctx.x: I mean, Durr, how do you spell it? D-U-R or D-O-E-R? D-U-R or something like that. I don't know anybody. What's the name of that trumpet player that played with Santa at the famous door of a long time? The famous door? Bill Gowdy? Yeah. Oh, yeah. I used to play with Bill Gowdy's daddy. Yeah, well.
He plays a nice trumpet. Was he good?
